intro: We do not publish flat prices for HVAC and plumbing work, because an honest number depends on what is actually wrong. What we do commit to is this: the estimate is free, it is written down before any work starts, and it is what you pay. Customers have told us in their own reviews that the final cost was within the estimate range and that there were no additional charges or fees. If your system can be repaired rather than replaced, we will tell you so — even when the replacement would be worth more to us. Call (570) 333-0380 and we will come out and give you a real number.
